children: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TSE:7267) is reshaping its global strategy—delaying CR-V hybrid mass production in North America while pursuing India‑specific, lower‑cost models and partnerships to rebuild market share, and advancing in‑motion EV charging and connected‑vehicle tech for Japan and India.
: Honda Motor Co. (7267) delayed mass production of next-gen CR-V hybrid in North America, moving start at Ohio and Indiana plants from March to at least May; no reason given.
: Honda Motor Co. (7267) partners to build India-specific vehicles: a sub‑4m SUV and a midsize SUV, both slated for launch beginning in 2028.
: Honda Motor Co. Sponsored ADR (7267) seeks a partnership in India to rebuild presence after EV-related losses; market share fell to ~1.3%. Company pursuing localized, lower-cost product strategy.
: Honda Motor Co. (7267) is developing magnetic-coupling wireless power transfer roads for in-motion EV charging with Taisei and Taisei Rotec; public road demonstrations start in Japan FY2027.
: Honda Motor Co. (7267) will test DWPT tech on the Tateyama Expressway from Japan’s FY2027, partnering with road operators for real-world verification.
: Honda Motor Co. (7267) provides connected-vehicle data for Japan–India digital infrastructure at India Mobile Congress 2026, supporting road-condition monitoring and smart mobility apps in India.
